item.title: Nepal Floods: Hunt intensifies for 900 missing at hydel units, one tunnel head located
item.description: As rescue operations intensify in Nepal, over 900 individuals remain unaccounted for in the aftermath of devastating floods that have led to 810 confirmed deaths in both Nepal and Tibet. Teams are utilizing advanced tools at the Upper Trishuli-3A hydropower project to search for survivors. Notably, several Indian nationals are among the missing, which has led India to provide crucial technical and relief assistance for the ongoing rescue efforts.
item.dc:creator: VISHANT AGARWALA AND KALYAN DAS

item.title: 'CJP netas not saints, nothing wrong in having political ambitions': Wangchuk
item.description: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk believes organizers of the Cockroach Janta Party movement have political ambitions. He stated that such aspirations are normal and not objectionable if the platform remains non-party. Wangchuk described the organizers as well-meaning and skilled individuals with no current indications of corruption. He advised them to maintain the CJP as a neutral pressure group for broader support.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Deepti Sharma scripts history! Stunning 3/0 makes her world's top T20I wicket-taker
item.description: Deepti Sharma has made history by becoming the leading wicket-taker in Women's T20I cricket, demonstrating her exceptional skills with a remarkable three wickets for no runs in a thrilling match against Thailand in Dubai. With Shafali Verma’s explosive 64 earlier contributing to a solid foundation, India celebrated a resounding 94-run victory, setting an exciting tone for their Asia Cup campaign.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: India, Uzbekistan target long-term uranium pact, set annual trade target of $5 bn
item.description: In a significant diplomatic move, India and Uzbekistan have enhanced their engagement to a comprehensive strategic partnership. They have ambitious plans for trade, aiming for a target of five billion dollars each year. The nations also formalized an agreement for uranium supply and created a foreign minister-level coordination council while signing eleven memorandums of understanding across diverse fields like mining and education.
item.dc:creator: SACHIN PARASHAR

item.title: Michael Dell shares a 'special note' for COO as he completes 39 years
item.description: Dell COO Jeff Clarke marked thirty-nine years with the technology company. This milestone coincides with Dell's major 'One Dell Way' transformation initiative. The company is consolidating multiple applications and systems into a single enterprise platform. This comprehensive change aims to simplify processes and enhance data flow across departments. The transformation is designed to prepare Dell for an AI-driven business environment.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: NEET-PG 2026 conducted smoothly; retest on Sept 5 for Jaipur candidates hit by glitch
item.description: The NEET-PG 2026 examination faced disruption due to a power failure at two Jaipur centres. A retest is scheduled for September 5 for 2,445 affected candidates. A three-member committee will investigate the internal power supply problem. The nationwide examination was conducted with extensive security measures and real-time monitoring. NBEMS expressed regret for the inconvenience caused to the candidates.
item.dc:creator: ANUJA JAISWAL

item.title: Diabetes impacts men, women differently: Study
item.description: Type 2 diabetes affects men and women with different health risks. Women face greater mental health challenges after diagnosis, while men experience more heart and kidney issues. Hypertension is a common complication for both sexes following diabetes. People developing mental health conditions after diabetes tend to die earlier. The study suggests sex-specific diabetes care and monitoring are needed.
item.dc:creator: ANUJA JAISWAL

item.title: After renaming ‘Gulf of Mexico’ to ‘Gulf of America’, Google Maps changes name of ‘Lake Ontario’
item.description: Google Maps has introduced a noteworthy update, displaying Lake Ontario as Lake America for American users. This decision aligns with a new presidential executive order and modifications to the GNIS. Canadian officials maintain the traditional name, highlighting its rich heritage over centuries. Meanwhile, alternative mapping platforms such as MapQuest and Apple Maps have not yet responded to this change, which is tailored regionally depending on the user's location.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Right to question not defiance, every dissent not a threat: SC judge
item.description: Supreme Court judge Ujjal Bhuyan stressed that governments must listen to citizens and allow dissent. He stated that questioning is an essential expression of citizenship and liberty in democracies. Universities should foster free thinking and encourage students to ask difficult questions. Intolerance undermines the constitutional framework when disagreement is silenced or punished. A democracy's maturity is shown by its response to unpopular or inconvenient opinions.
item.dc:creator: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA

item.title: Seychelles island restoration grew sooty tern colony from 20,000 to 700,000
item.description: Once threatened by severe ecological decline, Bird Island has transformed into a remarkable conservation achievement. Over decades of exploitation and farming, the island's environment was heavily damaged. However, when Guy Savy and partners took over in 1967, they began restoration and promoted eco-tourism. This initiative has led to a major recovery in seabird numbers, proving that long-term conservation can revitalize damaged ecosystems.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Superconductors finally prove quantum imaging effect predicted two decades ago
item.description: The University of Illinois Chicago’s Dirk Morr proposed a way to create high-resolution quantum images using superconductors two decades ago. A new experiment by researchers in Germany, supported by Morr’s theoretical model, has now produced quantum imaging similar to what he predicted, providing experimental confirmation of his earlier work.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: Amid software fears, Anthropic CEO says: ‘We’re not here to destroy anyone’
item.description: Anthropic's CEO assures investors that AI will not dismantle enterprise software companies. He views AI expansion as a positive, collaborative evolution for the technology sector. Wall Street experienced sell-offs after an AI announcement, but software firms have recovered. Salesforce reported strong growth and client retention, deepening its AI integration. Concerns persist regarding data security and enterprise autonomy with AI providers.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: How to avoid rental disputes: Delhi Police plans awareness session for Northeast tenants
item.description: Delhi Police will host an awareness program next week for Northeast residents. The event will focus on rental agreements and security deposit issues. Tenants will learn about their rights and responsibilities regarding rent. Police will widely circulate advisories with community leaders' help. This initiative aims to prevent and resolve landlord-tenant disputes effectively.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.dc:creator: SACHIN PARASHAR

item.title: Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf’s unique approach to raising their children
item.description: Andre Agassi made significant sacrifices during his own childhood to ensure his children could experience life freely. Becoming a father to Jaden and Jaz shifted his priorities, emphasizing their happiness over his own athletic legacy. His wife, Steffi Graf, who also faced the rigorous demands of elite sports, shared this perspective, allowing them to focus on nurturing their children's individual passions.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Logan Paul vs The Miz net worth 2026: WWE earnings and business ventures
item.description: Logan Paul and The Miz have taken very different paths to financial success in WWE. Paul has mixed digital media, boxing, wrestling and entrepreneurship, with PRIME Hydration playing a large part in his estimated fortune. The Miz, whose real name is Michael Gregory Mizanin, has amassed a fortune from a long career in WWE, reality television, acting, hosting, and other entertainment endeavors.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes donate $1.077M to 20 Kansas City charities
item.description: The Mahomes Foundation gala achieved a remarkable feat, raising more than one million dollars for charitable organizations in Kansas City. The evening benefited twenty local entities, making a substantial difference in the community. Brittany Mahomes shared her heartfelt appreciation for the positive influence they continue to have, emphasizing the foundation's dedication to children's health and community development through a variety of supportive initiatives.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Nepal floods: Stranger ran past school screaming ‘Run, water’. It saved 370 kids, teachers
item.description: An unidentified man's warning saved over 370 pupils and teachers from a massive flood. Students and staff scrambled to a forested hill as floodwaters surged rapidly. Communications were disrupted, making it difficult to account for all students after the event. One father tragically perished while attempting to reach the school for his son. The school continues efforts to trace pupils and reunite them with their families.
item.dc:creator: VISHANT AGARWALA

item.title: Russia strike on Kyiv ammunition depot kills 38 in year's deadliest attack as Zelenskyy blames officials
item.description: A devastating drone strike on an ammunition depot near Kyiv resulted in the tragic loss of 38 lives. The following blasts left unexploded shells scattered across civilian areas. In light of this catastrophe, Ukrainian authorities are re-evaluating their ammunition storage methods. Meanwhile, Russia has escalated its aerial assaults on Ukraine, prompting Kyiv to promise a stringent response to every act of aggression.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: 3 masked men rob Congress leader Alka Lamba's father's Delhi home; CCTV video emerges
item.description: Early Sunday, a shocking burglary took place at Alka Lamba's father's home in west Delhi, involving three masked thieves. They stole Rs 1.75 lakh in cash and a selection of jewelry, as recorded by nearby CCTV cameras. The incident occurred in the C-Block, Tagore Garden area, with police now analyzing the footage to identify the suspects and recover the stolen items.
item.dc:creator: RK LAXMI

item.title: Army aviation pilots pull off daring high-altitude helicopter rescue at 18,600ft in Ladakh
item.description: In a remarkable display of bravery, Indian Army Aviation pilots executed a complicated high-casualty evacuation near the Nun Kun massif. With no flat landing area available, they skillfully rescued a casualty from a steep slope, overcoming the challenges posed by high altitude, where helicopter engine efficiency is diminished. To aid the mission, the crew efficiently removed unnecessary equipment from the aircraft, showcasing their exceptional talent and valor.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: Kabul, Kashmir, Mumbai, Pahalgam: Hafiz Saeed’s deadly four-decade terror trail
item.description: India has formally charged Hafiz Muhammad Saeed, the founder of Lashkar-e-Taiba, in connection with a new case of terrorism. The Mumbai Police have initiated proceedings for a trial in absentia, highlighting the legacy of LeT across various phases. Originating from the Afghan jihad in the 1980s, the organization has transitioned from focusing on Kashmir insurgency to embracing a wider range of terror operations.
item.dc:creator: AYUSH PANDEY

item.title: KPSC veterinary recruitment scam: CID detains political party functionary in Delhi
item.description: The CID's inquiry into the veterinary officer recruitment scam is gaining momentum as Detained in Delhi, Basavaraj Kannale, a high-ranking functionary from Bidar district, comes under scrutiny. With established ties to the arrested IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar, investigators suspect Kannale's deeper involvement. He is being transported to Bengaluru for further questioning as the CID's investigation uncovers potential links to more accomplices in the case.
item.dc:creator: H M CHAITHANYA SWAMY

item.dc:creator: DIPAK K DASH

item.title: Best in 112 years! Robinson breaks Bumrah’s mark to claim Test’s best average
item.description: Ollie Robinson has reached a remarkable milestone in Test cricket, now boasting the best bowling average for bowlers who have played at least twenty Tests. This noteworthy achievement occurred during England's second Test against Pakistan at Lord's, where Robinson's crucial four-wicket spell effectively crushed Pakistan's resistance and solidified England's dominance in the fourth innings.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.dc:creator: LUBNA KABLY

item.title: Dipika and Shoaib’s festival vlogs; couple mark Eid and Rakhi; restaurant dream waits
item.description: Dipika Kakar and Shoaib Ibrahim joyfully celebrated Eid-E-Milad and Raksha Bandhan with their dear family. Despite battling liver cancer and undergoing infusion treatment, Dipika took the time to decorate their home. Shoaib, demonstrating his culinary skills, made kheer and accompanied his father for a health check-up. His sister Saba and niece Reza stopped by to tie the rakhi, while Shoaib shared his aspiration to open a restaurant one day.
item.dc:creator: etimes.in

item.title: Asia Cup: Shafali, Deepti help India seal convincing 94-run win over Thailand
item.description: India kicked off their Women's T20 Asia Cup with an impressive 94-run triumph against Thailand. Shafali Verma ignited the innings with her electrifying batting, laying a robust foundation for the team. The bowlers showcased their prowess, limiting Thailand to a modest score. Highlighting the match, Deepti Sharma reached a remarkable milestone, claiming the title of leading wicket-taker in women's T20I history, ensuring a triumphant start to the tournament for India.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: 2nd Test: England thrash Pakistan by 194 runs at Lord’s to take 2-0 series lead
item.description: England celebrated a spectacular 194-run victory over Pakistan at Lord's, clinching a commanding 2-0 lead in the three-match Test series. Despite their efforts, Pakistan's batsmen faltered, unable to surpass the 200-run mark. Ollie Robinson shone brightly, claiming eight wickets in a remarkable bowling display. This series victory represents England's first Test win since December 2024, boosting their confidence moving forward.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: TOI impact story: IISc eco-friendly foam moves from lab to market
item.dc:creator: CHETHAN KUMAR

item.title: Mandhana scripts history in Asia Cup, surpasses Suzie Bates for international record
item.description: In a remarkable feat during the Women’s Asia Cup match, Smriti Mandhana surpassed Suzie Bates to become the second-highest run-scorer in women's international cricket history, amassing an impressive total of 10,756 runs. Her exceptional performance supported India's 159-run total against Thailand, leading to a victorious start for the team in the tournament.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: 'BJP thinks it is bigger than RSS, it should listen to Mohan Bhagwat': CJP leader Dipke
item.dc:creator: KANCHAN YADAV

item.title: Bengaluru techie dies, lover injured after jumping from 7th-floor terrace following dispute
item.description: A 23-year-old software engineer died and her boyfriend was injured after a fall. The couple allegedly argued before going to the seventh-floor terrace of their accommodation. Police suspect the woman jumped and pulled her boyfriend along with her. The injured man is undergoing treatment and is reportedly out of danger. Further details are expected after the boyfriend gives his statement to authorities.
item.dc:creator: H M CHAITHANYA SWAMY

item.title: Passengers fume as SpiceJet Dubai flight delayed by nearly 18 hours at Amritsar airport
item.description: At Sri Guru Ramdas Ji International Airport, chaos erupted as a SpiceJet flight to Dubai experienced an extraordinary delay of nearly eighteen hours. Frustration mounted among passengers due to persistent schedule changes and a lack of clear communication from the airline. This situation prompted worries about missed work obligations and travel plans, while many sought refunds, specifically criticizing the airline for not providing accommodations during the lengthy wait.
item.dc:creator: YUDHVIR RANA

item.title: UP man rapes GF, kills her after taking sexual stimulant drug at hotel on birthday
item.description: A 23-year-old man allegedly booked a hotel room and consumed a sexual stimulant drug. He then raped his 22-year-old girlfriend and murdered her when she resisted. The woman, a Dalit, was returning to her village for Raksha Bandhan. Police recovered the victim's mobile phone and stimulant tablets from the accused. An FIR was registered under murder and rape sections of the BNS.
item.dc:creator: SUDEEP LAVANIA

item.title: Imran Khan row: PCB warns Pak players against speaking about jailed former captain
item.description: The Pakistan Cricket Board has instructed its players to refrain from making public comments about Imran Khan's health amidst his ongoing imprisonment and health concerns that have drawn international interest. The board deems an interview with Khan's sons as politically motivated. Former cricketers Moin Khan and Javed Miandad have voiced their support for his medical needs, while international cricket captains have reached out to Pakistan's Prime Minister regarding his situation.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: ‘Excessive speed’: 8-yr-old killed as woman driver on phone runs him over in Mumbai
item.description: An eight-year-old boy tragically died after being hit by a speeding car in Mumbai's Bandra area. The driver, a forty-five-year-old woman, was allegedly distracted by a mobile phone call. The incident occurred on John Baptist Road, near Jijamata Garden, on Sunday afternoon. The boy sustained severe injuries and was rushed to Holy Family Hospital. Police have arrested the woman and registered a case against her.
item.dc:creator: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI

item.title: SC plea seeks curbs on CJP’s Sept 5 protest march in Lutyens’ Delhi
item.dc:creator: PRIYANKA JAISWAL

item.title: 1,300 days, 36 innings, no 100: How Babar’s Test century drought became a long story
item.description: Babar Azam's quest for a Test century continues as he remains without a hundred since December 2022. Over the course of seventeen Tests and thirty-six innings, he has frequently come close with several fifties but has yet to convert those into three-figure scores. His challenges surged notably in 2024, despite a temporary revival in South Africa.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: Transporter found murdered in Lucknow; driver, aide detained
item.description: In a tragic incident, a transporter was discovered dead with two gunshot wounds after being reported missing. Authorities have detained his driver and an associate as part of the investigation. Preliminary findings indicate that a property dispute, valued at approximately eight crore rupees, may have been the motive behind this heinous act.
item.dc:creator: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
